summary: Teams use industry-standard software for word processing, spreadsheets, databases, presentations, and publishing to create professional business materials and streamline workflows. Contestants work together to ensure all communications meet organizational branding standards. All work is completed on-site and submitted electronically.
time_limits: no more than ten (10) minutes orientation
no more than ninety (90) minutes testing time
no more than ten (10) minutes wrap-up
submission_requirements: All student-produced jobs completed on-site are uploaded electronically and are not printed at the national level
Flash Drive (one per team, to be submitted with test materials after testing)
what_to_bring: Published and/or unpublished non-electronic written reference materials
competencies: Utilize industry-standard software for word processing, database management, spreadsheets, presentations, and desktop publishing to organize and merge data, analyze information, and create professional business materials across multiple applications to ensure efficiency
Demonstrate leadership and teamwork by evaluating tasks, delegating responsibilities, and managing priorities and timelines to optimize workflow and achieve organizational goals
Ensure all communications and materials adhere to organizational style and branding standards
judging_notes: AI Policy Level 1 No AI Allowed

Previous Business Professionals of America tests and/or sample tests (handwritten, photocopied or keyed) may not be taken into the testing area. Violation of this rule will result in disqualification.
eligibility_notes: A team will consist of 2-4 contestants.
Any secondary or postsecondary division contestant may enter this application event.
Each state is allowed three (3) entries
